The selected pages of this section cover the licensing and responsibilities of large-vehicle drivers, the visibility, space, stopping, acceleration, downgrade and slipstream limitations of large vehicles, hazardous materials and emergency equipment, towing trailers safely, and sharing the road with motorcycles at intersections, in lanes, when following and when passing; they teach how a car driver shares the road with large vehicles, trailers and motorcycles and say nothing about any examination; they state no exam name, question count, passing standard, format or time limit.

The run scope names the Hawaii Department of Transportation as the handbook issuer and the twenty twenty-three printing as the edition, but these pages carry no page-bound issuer or edition statement, so part A asserts no issuer or edition fact of its own.

Question count, passing standard, format and time limit for the class three knowledge test are not stated anywhere in this manual; every official exam fact stays unknown in this envelope and is never guessed.

Corpus note: the limitations, towing rules and motorcycle guidance are stable content printed in this twenty twenty-three edition, with the crash statistic stated only as printed and no annual-rewrite signal on these pages.
